verdict.rationale: Stagehand's docs say it caches `act()`, `observe()`, and `extract()` results to cut LLM cost and latency. The v3 docs add built-in auto-caching that turns agent-discovered workflows into deterministic scripts running 10-100x faster, and actions keep recorded selectors with optional `selfHeal` re-inference. The launch-era HN comments describing per-run regeneration predate these documented caching features and don't concretely contradict them. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that cached replays work, details on cache keys, invalidation and local vs server-side storage, and clarity on whether the v3 deterministic-agent caching carries over to v4.
